_comment: Row 289. Run this battery from a detached scratch tree under an inherited ignored mask: trap '' HUP INT QUIT PIPE; exec venv/bin/python toolchain/bin/bd-mutate --spec tests/mutants/row_289_inherited_signal_identity.json --work SCRATCH --timeout 240. Baseline must be green under that mask. M1/M2 prove both exact recording and fail-closed unavailable fields; M3 proves the terminal record is visible; M4 exercises capture.sh's real env --default-signal re-exec and must fail specifically at exit 126 when its generated subject is not executable; M5/M6 remove the two clean-lane resets and are caught only because the battery itself retains the ignored parent mask. The separate transform-control spec applies M1 to an import-only test and must ESCAPE.
subject: test-lane environment identity records SigIgn and SigBlk while signal-sensitive tests establish their own claimed dispositions

mutants.label: M1 context silently omits both process signal masks
mutants.new:
# MUTANT: omit signal identity from the recorded context.
    return ctx

mutants.label: M2 unavailable procfs fields become clean-looking zero masks
M3 terminal context hides SigIgn and SigBlk despite persisting them
mutants.old:
write("run context: %s, %d cores, %s worker(s) via %s, dist=%s, "
          "SigIgn=%s, SigBlk=%s, load %s -> %s"
          % (ctx["host"], ctx["cores"], ctx["workers"], ctx["workers_from"],
             ctx["dist"], ctx.get("sigign", "UNKNOWN"),
             ctx.get("sigblk", "UNKNOWN"), ctx.get("load_at_start"),
             ctx.get("load_at_end")))
mutants.new:
write("run context: %s, %d cores, %s worker(s) via %s, dist=%s, "
          "load %s -> %s"
          % (ctx["host"], ctx["cores"], ctx["workers"], ctx["workers_from"],
             ctx["dist"], ctx.get("load_at_start"), ctx.get("load_at_end")))

mutants.label: M4 generated capture probe is not executable for capture.sh re-exec
mutants.old:
probe.chmod(0o755)
    assert os.access(probe, os.X_OK), (
        "the capture probe is not executable, so its inherited-signal re-exec "
        "would stop at exit 126 instead of exercising the requested subject"
    )
mutants.new: assert probe.is_file(), "MUTANT retained a non-executable probe"

mutants.label: M5 detached-launch tests inherit pytest's ignored signals instead of constructing their subject
M6 bd-run clean control inherits pytest's ignored signals and cries wolf
